elements.label: Figure 5.5
elements.title: Monthly Consumption of Coal for Electricity Generation in the United States from 2016 to 2022

details.values: Peaks around 70,000 in early 2016 and early 2017; general downward trend with fluctuations; minimum near 20,000 around early 2020; values mostly between 30,000 and 60,000 after 2019; multiple ups and downs visible throughout the timeline.

elements.summary: This line chart shows the monthly coal consumption for electricity generation in the US from 2016 to 2022, illustrating fluctuations with an overall downward trend over the period.
